items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: I played with Rabbit a couple of times, but Rabbit played so bad I had to let him go.

ctx.x: That passed just two blocks, one block across James Allen. That's where Rabbit used to hang out. That's right. I know Rabbit. That's right. I played with Rabbit a couple of times, but Rabbit played so bad I had to let him go.
